en: Black-and-white view of a historic town square with a large Gothic/Renaissance-style town hall dominating the scene. The building has a steeply pitched tiled roof, three stepped-gable façades, a slender central spire, and a clock. On the ground floor is an arched entrance and a sign reading "Rathskeller" above an awning. To the right stands a building with a sign "Hôtel zum" and a horse-drawn carriage in front. On the left, multi-story townhouses line the street, one marked with the vertical sign "F. Richard Fladriz." Several pedestrians stand or walk across the cobblestone square.
